title: Forearm Mobility
texts:
Complete 8 sets total (4 on each arm) of each of the following static positions.  
Hold the most stretched position possible where you feel slight discomfort but not pain.  
Complete all sets of each position before moving to the next exercise. 

You will have 30 seconds to rest each side as you stretch the other hand. 
10 seconds is given to shake out between hands. 

To maintain flexibility in your forearms, each position should be held for 30 seconds.
